posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
LeRoiManlo said:
My software displays big purple areas around elements
Click to expand...
That purple is your placeholder for transparency - everything you see as purple will be transparent when the game is running. That is proven by the purple in the tileset itself top left.
LeRoiManlo said:
No its all time like this. For example when i create a new map
Click to expand...
yes, because as above a new map has nothing in it, so you'll see the purple placeholder for transparence everywhere.
your problem is that you placed the tree tile of the original screenshot on the lowest layer, replacing the floor that should be there and since the frame around the tree on the tile is transparent, you'll see the background purple behind the map.
you need to place the floor there again, then go to a higher layer and place the tree on the higher layer, like you did with the other parts of that map.

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body:
It's worth noting that XP doesn't always sub in purple for transparency! Normally it's a very pale blue, but I've also seen it use ultramarine, magenta, cyan--I have no idea why. I used it for 15 years before I ever saw this happen to one of my friends, and it seemed to pick a different bright color every time he reinstalled hoping to fix it XD I thought it was a stand-alone vs Steam issue, but the copy of the stand-alone I got over the summer gave me the usual pale blue. I'd love to know why it
sometimes
does this, if anyone has the answer!
Like Andar said, the reason you're seeing purple around the tree in the first screenshot is because you've put the tree on the same layer as the ground. And like Harlekin said, it shouldn't show up purple if you hit playtest--it will show up black, unless you've set a panorama for that tileset.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
the selection of the transparency color in RMXP has been broken for years.
the problem is most likely that the way it was stored in the registry is no longer compatible with modern windows versions, and this broken storage is one reason for the sometime randomly changing color.
however that is just optics and changes nothing on how transparency works.
